question: Out of his total income, Sanjay spends 20% on house rent and 70% of the rest on household expenses. If he saves ₹1,800, then his total income is:
solution:
**Given:**

Savings = ₹1,800

House rent = 20% of total income

Household expenses = 70% of the rest

**Formula Used:**

Total income = Savings / (1 - House rent% - Household expenses% of rest)
